findings.text: follow-on: the Physics Categories section states the categories are "listed in precedence order", but that list is rendered from imas_codex/llm/prompt_loader.py:619 category_guidance.items() in domains.yaml insertion order, not reordered by the precedence as the Physics Domains section is, so an edit to the precedence can silently make the prompt's own claim false while every test stays green.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit 0faae66faa2ccd151b485115b287dd21cb5a16ff against its parent bc5acb919a70b460a3aed4d8cfa28ec73bdc1b85; seven files changed (domains.yaml, definitions/physics/__init__.py, domain_ranking.py, dd_domain_classifier.py, domain_classifier.md, the new test file, the landing fragment), all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks that stubbed tests show the selector and the rendered question read one order from the guidance file, that the loader refuses a missing or repeated domain, and that the tree questions and chat prompt carry the tie-break with options in precedence order; tests/graph/test_domain_precedence.py carries those assertions and the manifest records the base and head runs.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is one declared domain precedence kept in the guidance file and read by both the standard-name selector and the DD path classifier; imas_codex/definitions/physics/domains.yaml:22 adds the `precedence` block and imas_codex/standard_names/domain_ranking.py:15 derives FALLBACK_RANK_TABLE from load_domain_precedence().
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records base 173 passed and head 180 passed both EXIT=0, a negative-control red arm at tests/graph/test_domain_precedence.py, and the shas bc5acb919a70b460a3aed4d8cfa28ec73bdc1b85 to 0faae66faa2ccd151b485115b287dd21cb5a16ff.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared write paths (7 entries); every path in the landed commit is inside them and no file outside them was touched.

justifications.durability: tests/graph/test_domain_precedence.py:100 fails when the tuple is restored or the question loses its rule (negative-control.log), but the chat prompt's category-list order claim in imas_codex/llm/prompts/imas/domain_classifier.md:20 is asserted by no test.
justifications.evidence: the gate run recorded in the manifest (gate-base.log / gate-head.log) is the brief's named file set plus the new file, 173->180 passed EXIT=0, and the negative-control.log shows two of the added tests red under the reverted tuple and the removed rule.
justifications.fit: PRECEDENCE_TIEBREAK_RULE, _precedence_rank and _category_precedence_rank at imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py:136-171 are mechanism-named and carry no plan or gate label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/definitions/physics/__init__.py:86 load_domain_precedence() is the one order domain_ranking.py:15 and dd_domain_classifier.py:_domain_options both read, so a name and a path settle an overlap the same way.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the one owner, imas_codex/definitions/physics/__init__.py, and domain_ranking.py:15 derives from it rather than forking; _precedence_rank() at imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py:139 re-derives a domain-index map that domain_ranking._RANK_INDEX already holds privately.
justifications.scope_discipline: the landed commit touches only imas_codex/definitions/physics/domains.yaml, imas_codex/definitions/physics/__init__.py, imas_codex/standard_names/domain_ranking.py, imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py, imas_codex/llm/prompts/imas/domain_classifier.md, tests/graph/test_domain_precedence.py and the landing fragment, all within the declared write paths.
